title: Canonical tensor-completion chain map and its normalized components
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme W [def-pc-scheme]. Use the completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and signed total tensor on two arbitrary cochain complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation]. The canonical Roos augmentation composed with Roos of the normalized strict tensor-tower isomorphism gives a natural chain map from ordinary total tensor to the completed tensor representative [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models]. Its component on P,Q is exactly the normalized tensor operation unit, with the native representative as target. No boundedness, constructibility or residue-field invertibility hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For functors F,U,V,R, a natural transformation from the identity to U followed by R and a natural isomorphism F followed by U to V give a natural transformation from F to V followed by R. Define its component by the two actual maps. Its naturality follows from their naturality equations, functoriality and associativity.

Apply this construction to signed total tensor, the strict quotient tower, the finite tensor tower, and the Roos functor. The component is definitionally the actual tensorOperationUnit. The required Roos unit naturality is the existing proved sliceRoosUnit_natural.
